maddeler.e:
استذهنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَذْهَنُوا (istaḏhanū) /is.tað.ha.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# اُسْتُذْهِنُوا (ustuḏhinū) /us.tuð.hi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
# اِسْتَذْهِنُوا (istaḏhinū) /is.tað.hi.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَذْهَنَ (istaḏhana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
